## v7.8.62 — 2026-10-27 · the warm queue + a third-party widget hold to test
- **Change:** a **warm queue in the mu-plugin** (survives uninstall), emitted with APO's page cache. One queue, four priorities:
  **0 = you** (Cache Manager / admin bar Revalidate, a pasted URL - goes first, at once), **1 = an edited page** + its home and terms,
  **2 = a stale copy** (the serve-stale path now queues instead of firing a revalidate per hit), **3 = sitemap coverage** (daily: every
  sitemap page without a copy or with one older than 7 days). **One URL at a time** (lock), phone + desktop, then a pause of
  **max(2 s, 1.5 x that pair's render time)** scheduled through WP-Cron - **no sleep()**, so no PHP worker is ever held waiting (the old
  prewarm slept inside a 25 s tick and did 12 renders a minute). Brakes: an error / 429 / 5xx / render over 8 s pauses it 10 min, a second
  stops it until Resume; the server's load average above its CPU count makes it wait. A page still learning (`X-APO-Degraded`) gets
  one more pass later, max 3 (usually 1-2 instead of a fixed 3). After rebuilding a priority-0/1 page, that URL's host/CDN copy is
  purged. **Clean logs:** a warm request is a plain GET of the real URL with a signed `X-APO-Warm` header (HMAC, per-site key) and an
  honest `APO-Warm/1` user-agent - no `?apo_revalidate=1`; a forged or missing signature gets the normal cached copy. **Phone copies
  now revalidate:** the old serve-stale rebuild always sent a desktop user-agent, so a stale phone copy was rebuilt as desktop. The
  drop-in accepts the signed header, rebuilds with the device's user-agent, at most once a minute per copy; the upgrade auto-refresh
  now rewrites APO's own drop-in too (a parked or foreign one is never touched); the queue retries the old way if an older drop-in
  answers from its copy. **Maximum only (`warm_lazy_inv`): an edit marks the copy stale** (visitors keep it at once) and the queue
  rebuilds it first, instead of deleting it; trash / unpublish / slug change still delete (v7.8.60). Cache Manager: queue status
  (waiting per priority, building now, done, pace, ETA, last 20) + Prewarm whole site / Pause / Resume / Empty. The main plugin's
  prewarm hands its URLs to the queue wherever it exists (never two warmers).
  **Also (test switch, not a default): third-party WIDGETS held to the first interaction or 10 s** (`?apo_x=APO_X_TP_WIDGET`, or define
  it). koirala's TBT 1.5-3 s came from a widget the SITE added (a Jobber work-request form + reCAPTCHA) running in Turbo++'s held pass
  1 s after load. The delay loader now classifies each held script from the page itself - a script from another site, or an inline
  snippet that injects one, is a widget; WordPress assets on any CDN, library CDNs (jsdelivr, cdnjs, unpkg, ajax.googleapis,
  code.jquery), consent managers, trackers (own timers), payment, and a first-party script using jQuery / Elementor are not; a small
  inline init right after a widget goes with it - widgets are re-typed `apo/tpw` (so no APO wait or preload counts them) and run after
  the held pass, one at a time in idle time, on the next interaction or after `APO_TPW_MS` (10 s); never on cart / checkout / account.
  Kill `APO_NO_TP_WIDGET`.
- **Presets:** the queue wherever APO's page cache is emitted (Maximum, Auto, or ticked) - no-layout-risk (when a page is rebuilt, not
  what is in it). `warm_lazy_inv` (an edit served stale until rebuilt) = carries risk -> **Maximum only**. Presets without the page cache
  emit v7.8.61's code line for line. Turbo++ on WP Engine keeps the main plugin's existing prewarm (next: give it the same pacing).
- **Worst case:** server load while the queue has work = one extra PHP request every few seconds (guards above; an empty queue = zero
  work); after an edit on Maximum, visitors see the previous copy until its priority-1 rebuild (seconds with traffic; logged-in editors
  always see fresh); a quiet site's queue waits for the next visit (WP-Cron) - your own Revalidate of one or two URLs runs at once.
- **Kill switches:** `APO_NO_WARM_QUEUE` (= v7.8.61), `APO_NO_LAZY_INV` (edits delete); widget hold: `APO_NO_TP_WIDGET`, `APO_TPW_MS`; `APO_WQ_NO_LOADCHECK`, `APO_WQ_MAX` (sitemap cap,
  1000), `APO_WQ_REFRESH_DAYS` (7).
- **Measured:** `test_v7862` 55/55: settings = v7.8.61 + `warm_lazy_inv` on Maximum only; no-page-cache presets byte-identical; the emitted
  queue in a stubbed WordPress - your URL first, this site only and no query strings, plain URL + signature + honest UA, pause >= 2 s and
  >= 1.5 x render, lock, brake (pause, stop), re-pass max 3, old-drop-in fallback, host purge only after an edited page, signature
  valid/forged/missing, sitemap coverage skips fresh copies, Pause / Resume / Empty, lazy edit keeps the copy stale (v7.8.61 control
  deleted it and nothing rebuilt it), trash still deletes, kill switch; the GENERATED drop-in over real HTTP (php -S) - plain served,
  signed falls through, forged served, stale served + one throttled rebuild; v7.8.61's drop-in served the signed request (control).
  Widget hold: the EMITTED loader in real Chrome on a fixture - 3 widgets classified (injector, its init, cross-origin script; not the
  library CDN, a WordPress asset on another host, a jQuery-using first-party script or a tracker), the held pass runs without them,
  the next interaction (or 4 s with APO_TPW_MS=4000) runs them in order; switch off and the v7.8.61 loader = one pass as before. 63/63.
